mapper.select: SELECT u.external_id AS user_external_id, u.organization_uuid AS org_uuid FROM users u WHERE LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(#{email}) ORDER BY u.registration_identity DESC, u.added_at ASC, u.uuid ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{defaultName}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE external_id = #{userExternalID} AND name = ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, email, name, role, registration_identity) VALUES (#{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.Email}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Role}, true) RETURNING uuid
mapper.select: SELECT u.uuid, u.external_id, u.organization_uuid, u.email, u.name, u.role, u.added_at FROM users u JOIN organizations o ON o.uuid = u.organization_uuid WHERE u.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(#{email}) AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY u.added_at ASC, u.uuid ASC LIMIT 1
